entities.name: Raven's Run
entities.description: Gloomy Shadowmoor counterpart of Wren's Run.

entities.name: Strongroot
entities.description: Last safehold in the forest, fell to Amur's black poplars.

entities.name: Joram Twohorns
entities.description: Born in Strongroot and evicted at 14 for having no horns; renamed himself after being given horns by the sphere.

entities.name: Amur Brokenlimb
entities.description: Canker witch treefolk who gave Joram the copper sphere.

entities.name: Copper sphere
entities.description: Sphere that granted Joram horns at a price.

events.summary: Joram is evicted from Strongroot at 14 for having no horns.
events.quote: until he was evicted from the village at 14 years of age for having no horns

events.summary: Amur gives Joram the copper sphere, granting him horns.
events.quote: who gave him the copper sphere, which granted him the wish of getting horns

events.summary: The sphere's payment spreads the Canker curse to Strongroot's defenders and the safehold falls to Amur's black poplars.
events.quote: it fell to Amur's black poplars

relations.quote: who gave him the copper sphere
